title: ハロハロ Halloween🎃
creator: jiimo
caption_raw: ⭐ハロウィンの夜、憧れの君を追いかけて迷い込んだのは、不思議で可愛い魔法の国。🪄お菓子の馬車、逆さ時計、猫の案内人。迷子の先で待っていたのは、ずっと会いたかった君でした。🎃　⭐On Halloween night, a girl chasing her crush wanders into a magical world of candy carriages, upside-down clocks, and mysterious cats. 🪄And waiting at the end of her adventure is the boy she’s always dreamed of. 🎃
style_raw: Dance-pop with a bright Halloween bounce; charming, breathy high female lead with light doubles; buoyant syncopated pulse and springy melody; heavy bouncing kick and bass, sparkling keys, finely strummed acoustic guitar; guitar spins across a wide, dimensional 270-degree stereo field, chorus opens into a full dance beat, with quirky breaks, abrupt rhythmic turns, and a playful final pivot
lyrics_raw:

Trick or treat—see you soon!

----- English Lyrics -----
Title : Hello Hello Halloween🎃

[Intro]
Tick-tock, candy clock
Round and round, follow the sign
Trick or treat, follow me!

[Verse 1]
I tie my red ribbon once again
Hurrying to the one I adore
I turned the corner, just as planned
But a strange new moon is smiling at me

[Pre-Chorus]
The ink on my map grows wings and flies
Slipping softly right out of my hand
Where could this door be leading to?
One, two, three—let's open it!

[Chorus]
Hello, hello Halloween, come along!
Ride the candy carriage, cross the stars
Lost along the way, my heart is bouncing
To the magic kingdom's castle tonight!
Hello, hello Halloween, what a dream!
Tie a pumpkin-colored ribbon in my hair
When the prince turns around to me—
Wait, is that the one I adore?

[Verse 2]
A silver staircase, led by a cat
Moonlight drops inside our teacups
“You're late,” he says with a smile
Calling out my name in that familiar voice

[Odd Break]
Stop! Right? Left? Spin around!
Tap-tap, tiptoe—the clock's upside down
La-la, abracadabra!
There's another pumpkin door!

[Interlude]

[Bridge]
If this is a dream, please let it stay
If we have to go, we'll find the way
There's a little leaf upon your cape
Just like the marker from the road we took

[Final Chorus]
Hello, hello Halloween, come along!
Ride the candy carriage, cross the stars
Lost along the way, hand in hand
Let's race through this magical world tonight
Hello, hello Halloween, what a dream!
My pumpkin-colored ribbon dances in the breeze
The prince was you all along
Wait, you've been here the whole time?

[Outro]
Tick-tock, candy clock
Round and round, the way back home
Trick or treat—see you soon!
